summary: Created `desk:apps:temp`; it opens with `C:` and `F: ?`, and its app code only changes input state, without reading or changing pages.

files.desk:apps:temp:
app 'Celsius to Fahrenheit'
task start()
give {c: '' }
done
task key(s, k)
when k is 'backspace'
when count(s.c) > 0
set s.c to slice(s.c, 1, count(s.c) - 1)
done
otherwise
when count(k) is 1 and starts('0123456789-.', k)
set s.c to s.c & k
done
done
give s
done
task draw(s)
show(1, 1, 'C: ' & s.c)
when is_number(s.c)
show(2, 1, 'F: ' & (number(s.c) * 9 / 5 + 32))
otherwise
show(2, 1, 'F: ?')
done
done
